name: tool-guard
description: Holds commands that lose work (git, rm, migrations), previews what they would change and lets you decide; checks commit subject format and removes the Claude trailer

commit_format.title: Check commit subject format
commit_format.description: A commit subject that does not match the format is blocked and Claude is asked to fix it. The default format is `<emoji> type(scope)!: description` (Conventional Commits); commit_pattern sets your own.

commit_pattern.title: Commit subject format (regular expression)
commit_pattern.description: Empty means the built-in Conventional Commits format.

strip_attribution.title: Remove the Claude trailer
strip_attribution.description: Remove Claude's Co-Authored-By trailer from commit messages.
